mechanics.label: Typed Card Counters
mechanics.currentScopeNote: V1.9.12 uses typed card counters for virus, recurring_credit and power pools on the target cards.

mechanics.label: Virus Counters and Corp Purge
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Corp-only three-click purge removes Virus counters and leaves non-virus counters intact.

mechanics.label: Recurring Pool Refresh
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Runner programs and resources with recurringCredits initialize counters and refresh without accumulation at Runner start of turn. The Shell Traders was removed from this recurring-credit family in the completion repair.

mechanics.label: The Shell Traders Set Aside and Delayed Install
mechanics.currentScopeNote: The Shell Traders can set aside Runner grip program/hardware cards face-up with public Shell counters, remove counters via Runner start-of-turn triggers or the 1-credit paid ability, and auto-install the target without normal install credit costs when the last Shell counter is removed. MU pressure is handled through a Runner trash-to-free-MU choice; broader paid windows remain limited to Runner main, encounter and movement windows.

mechanics.label: Scored Agenda Counter Economy
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Detroit Police Contract uses typed scored-agenda counter spend; Employee Empowerment applies start-of-turn Corp credits.
